name: Iuchi Temur
concept: His fingers are stained dark from the compounds he brews, the stains spreading further up his hands each week despite scrubbing, so he keeps his hands moving when he talks to hide them in the folds of his sleeves.

answers.giri: Temur serves his Unicorn daimyō by reporting on the Dragon's affliction, but he treats every sick person he encounters, which means his reports arrive incomplete and his daimyō cannot trust them entirely.
answers.ninjo: Temur writes letters to his beloved that he never sends, each one asking whether she has found someone else to care for her while he remains with the Dragon.
answers.standout_quality: Temur compounds medicines for the other students' minor ailments without being asked, which means he arrives late to his own practice and has twice failed to complete assignments on time.
answers.accomplishment: Temur stopped the fever in the Dragon's garrison by brewing a compound from plants he had never seen before, working through three nights without sleeping, and the soldiers who had been dying began to recover.
answers.challenge: Temur brews a remedy he is certain will work, doses a Dragon soldier with it, and only after the man recovers does he wonder whether the fever broke from the medicine or despite it—but by then he has already sent word to his daimyō that the compound is proven.
answers.peace: Temur sits in the theater gallery with a handful of other watchers, following the onnagata's careful gestures through a love scene, and for two hours he does not think about whether his letters should have been sent.
answers.fear: Temur doses a patient with a compound he is certain will work, and only after the man recovers does he wonder whether the fever broke from the medicine or despite it—but the doubt arrives too late, because he has already sent word to his daimyō that the remedy is proven.
answers.accoutrement: He wears a medicine pouch sewn from Dragon silk, a gift from the garrison commander whose fever he broke, and he has never opened it to check whether the contents are truly his compounds or something the Dragon packed inside.

clan_relationship.text: Temur reports what the Dragon's healers tell him rather than what he observes, which keeps his daimyō satisfied but means he cannot warn the Unicorn if the affliction truly spreads.

answers.first_impression: His fingers are stained dark from the compounds he brews, the stains spreading further up his hands each week despite scrubbing, so he keeps his hands moving when he talks to hide them in the folds of his sleeves.
answers.stress_reaction: When pressed past his composure, Temur's fingers go still inside his sleeves, and he stops moving them at all.
answers.relationships:
Asako Buncho (Phoenix) — Asako Buncho tends the Phoenix shrine near the Dragon garrison, and Temur brings her his failed compounds—the batches that curdled or wouldn't set—because she burns them properly instead of letting them seep into the ground, but he has never asked her what she does with the ash.
Baikin (Qamarist Alchemist Tradition) — Baikin taught Temur a technique for stabilizing volatile compounds that he uses daily, but Temur has never told his daimyō because the method comes from outside Unicorn tradition and his reports claim the compounds are entirely his own work.

bio:
Iuchi Temur is a Unicorn shugenja and healer, sent to aid the Dragon Clan while ensuring that any affliction affecting them does not spread to his own people. His duty is to uncover the nature of the threat before it spreads, balancing his compassionate instincts with the need to protect the Unicorn. Though he follows Bushidō, he prioritizes kindness over rigid duty, believing that a healer's first obligation is to those in need.

Temur wears furs, his beard carefully braided, and his hair in a bun, presenting himself as rugged yet composed. He carries himself with calm reassurance, making others feel safe and cared for. Despite this, he suppresses his homesickness, longing to return to the one he loves, while fearing that his duty may cost him his own happiness.

He finds peace in caring for his steed and compounding medicines, yet he struggles to take care of his own needs, constantly prioritizing others before himself. Though he once contained a deadly outbreak, proving his worth as a healer, he fears the corruption of the Shadowlands most of all, knowing that even magic has its limits.
